_help: Shop settings used by the basket page and by the checkout on the server.
Amounts are in pounds, e.g. 15 or 7.50.
DELIVERY IS SWITCHED OFF ('enabled': false) until you fill it in. While it is off, no delivery charge is added.
To charge delivery: set delivery.enabled to true and fee to the amount. free_over = order value (before delivery) that gets free delivery, or null.
minimum_order: set enabled to true and amount to the minimum basket value.
collection: set enabled to true to offer free collection at checkout, and fill in the address.
